themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe continue to emphasize 'national priority' policies, restricting benefits and services to citizens while opposing immigration. This theme appears prominently in Spain, Italy, and Sweden, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Lega, and Sverigedemokraterna advocating for stricter controls on social aid, housing, and education for non-citizens.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes eliminating Arabic language classes in schools and enforcing 'national priority' in social aid and housing, prioritizing Spanish citizens over immigrants.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for deregulation policies that prioritize Italian citizens in social services and opposes EU migration pacts.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Pushes for stricter citizenship laws and prioritizes Swedish nationals in welfare benefits, sparking internal debates over voting tactics.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes immigration policies and advocates for prioritizing French citizens in social services and employment.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes stricter immigration controls and prioritizes Norwegian citizens in welfare and housing policies.

themes.title: Trump’s policies dominate global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's influence on global right-wing discourse remains strong, with his policies and endorsements shaping political narratives in the U.S., Poland, Argentina, and Italy. Coverage focuses on his administration's economic, immigration, and foreign policies, as well as his impact on domestic and international elections.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Argentina's far-right party aligns with Trump's economic policies, emphasizing deregulation and anti-corruption measures.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing parties discuss Trump's foreign policy, particularly his stance on Iran and Cuba, as a model for Italy's international relations.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: UK right-wing media covers Trump's influence on British politics, particularly his impact on immigration and economic policies.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are gaining traction in polls, challenging traditional conservative and centrist parties. This trend is evident in Germany, Sweden, France, Spain, and Norway, where parties like AfD, Sverigedemokraterna, Rassemblement National, Vox, and Fremskrittspartiet are leading or making significant gains in recent surveys.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in several German states, surpassing traditional parties like CDU and SPD, with strong support in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Continues to gain support in Swedish polls, influencing national policies on immigration and welfare.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Leads French polls ahead of the 2027 presidential election, with Jordan Bardella as a prominent figure.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Gains seats in regional elections, particularly in Andalusia, and influences coalition governments with the PP.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Achieves record-high polling numbers, leading Norwegian political discourse on immigration and economic policies.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across multiple countries are experiencing internal conflicts, with factions competing for influence and leadership. These divisions are evident in Poland, Hungary, Argentina, Italy, and the UK, where parties like PiS, Fidesz, La Libertad Avanza, Fratelli d'Italia/Lega, and Reform UK face public disputes and leadership challenges.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Faces internal conflicts between factions led by Jarosław Kaczyński and Mateusz Morawiecki, with disputes over leadership and policy direction.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's Fidesz faces internal challenges following its electoral defeat, with the Tisza Party emerging as a rival force.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Experiences public disputes between factions led by Javier Milei, Martín Menem, and Santiago Caputo, with tensions over policy and leadership.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Internal divisions between Matteo Salvini and Giorgia Meloni over policy direction, including economic measures and immigration.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Faces internal disputes over leadership and candidate selection, with some councillors suspended or resigning over controversial statements.

themes.title: Meloni-Modi diplomacy reshapes EU-India ties

countries.name: 🇮🇳 General (India)
countries.note: Modi's government highlights the strategic importance of Italy-India relations, with agreements on defense, AI, and critical minerals.

countries.name: 🇪🇺 EU Context
countries.note: The EU observes Italy-India cooperation as a model for strengthening ties with Indo-Pacific partners, particularly in trade and security.
